sentences.text: Meteora is the second studio album by American rock band Linkin Park .	Linkin Park	Linkin Park	rock	rock music
It was released on March 25 , 2003 through Warner Bros. .

Records , following Reanimation , a collaboration album which featured remixes of songs included on their debut studio album Hybrid Theory .	Hybrid Theory	Hybrid Theory	Reanimation	Reanimation (Linkin Park album)
The album was produced by the band alongside Don Gilmore .
The title Meteora is taken from the Greek Orthodox monasteries sharing the same name .	Greek Orthodox monasteries	Meteora
Meteora has a similar sound to Hybrid Theory , as described by critics , and the album took almost a year to be recorded .	Hybrid Theory	Hybrid Theory
The main artwork was assembled by the band with help of various other graphic artists .

Linkin Park released singles from Meteora for over a year , including `` Somewhere I Belong '' , `` Faint '' , `` Numb '' , `` From the Inside '' and `` Breaking the Habit '' .	Linkin Park	Linkin Park	Somewhere I Belong	Somewhere I Belong	Faint	Faint (song)	Numb	Numb (Linkin Park song)	From the Inside	From the Inside (song)	Breaking the Habit	Breaking the Habit
The song `` Lying from You '' was released as a promotional single .	Lying from You	Lying from You
Meteora is the most successful album in the history of the Alternative Songs chart .	Alternative Songs	Alternative Songs
As of 2013 , the album has sold over 27 million copies worldwide , and is certified four times platinum by the RIAA .
Meteora was also ranked number 36 on Billboards Top 200 Albums of the Decade .

The song `` Session '' was nominated for the 2004 Grammy Award for Best Rock Instrumental Performance , losing to Jeff Beck 's `` Plan B '' .	Grammy Award for Best Rock Instrumental Performance	Grammy Award for Best Rock Instrumental Performance	Jeff Beck	Jeff Beck	Plan B	Jeff (album)
Some songs from the album were remixed with some of Jay-Z 's songs for the EP Collision Course .	Jay-Z	Jay-Z	Collision Course	Collision Course (album)
It is the first Linkin Park studio album to feature Dave Farrell after he rejoined the band in 2000 .	Linkin Park	Linkin Park
